name: claude-captain-mods
description: Claude Code desktop mods for running many sessions at once: a session board pane with macOS banners, and a status band above the prompt.

plugins.name: session-board
plugins.description: A pane listing every recent Claude Code session on this machine with its state, and a macOS banner when one finishes or waits on you.

plugins.name: devline
plugins.description: A quiet band above the prompt: project, branch and uncommitted changes, the prompt cache's time left, and a call-out when another session wants a look.
